description: This file defines the AccountService class in a Java Spring application, responsible for reading and retrieving bank and utility account data via repositories and mappers.

classes.name: AccountService
classes.description: A service class managing retrieval of bank and utility accounts using repositories and mappers, annotated as a Spring Service.

methods.name: readBankAccount
methods.description: Retrieves a BankAccount DTO based on the provided account number, throws EntityNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: readUtilityAccount
methods.description: Retrieves a UtilityAccount DTO based on the provider name, throws EntityNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: readUtilityAccount
methods.description: Retrieves a UtilityAccount DTO based on the account ID, throws EntityNotFoundException if not found.
